label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 139
title: Tier-creation UI: show all model attributes + per-agent fit while creating/assigning; auto-create
body: Dashboard tier-creation screen must show, for each model: provider, context_window, max_output, tools, reasoning, structured_outputs, input/output modality, pricing, quality/speed — AND, per agent, the fit verdict (good/not) with reasons + a recommended alternate. Auto-create: one click builds a tier from the catalog (best-fit per agent), shown for confirmation before saving. Consumes core/model_catalog.py + the auto-tier backend. All attributes visible during creation and agent assignment.
